question: Which of the following defence or para military forces of India has instituted a special 'Shakti Award' in March 2020, which will be annually presented to chosen personnel who works for the empowerment of women?
solution:
​ The correct answer is __**Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On July 27, 1939, the **Central Reserve Police Force** was established as the Crown Representative's Police. 
 
• **India's largest Central Armed Police Force** is the Central Reserve Police Force. The Ministry of Home Affairs of the Government of India is in** charge of its operations.**
 
• **The CRPF has established a special "Shakti Award"** that will be granted yearly to a selected member of staff who works to advance **women's rights.**
 
• The **honour was announced soon before March 8th**, International Women's Day, and will be presented annually on March 19th, CRPF **Raising Day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• On February 1st, 1977, the interim **Indian Coast Guard (ICG)** was established, with five patrol vessels and two small corvettes transferred from the **Indian Navy.**
 
• With only **three battalions**, the **Central Industrial Security Force** was established in 1969 to offer integrated security coverage to specific important** public sector businesses.**
 
• The largest and most land-based branch of the **Indian Armed Forces is the Indian Army**. The Chief of Army Staff, a four-star general, is the **Indian Army's professional commander.**
